plan.close_all: No pre-market close. Hold all four open layers; they remain segregated with fixed collateral and will only close via take-profit or liquidation.
plan.hostage_policy: RP remains 2500 notional with 2500 collateral. Use up to 4 layers of 625 notional each; risk per layer is $25 collateral. No manual stop orders; each layer is isolated by its $625 collateral, so liquidation is the only stop. Open only when a limit-buy trigger is traded through and a layer slot is free. If aggregate unrealized NAV of open layers is below -$100, pause new entries; otherwise wait. Do not exceed 4 concurrent layers. If all four slots are occupied, hold NAV(-) positions rather than cutting, because each layer's risk is already collateral-isolated; wait for TP or liquidation.
